svg.title: Ottodot Trial Booking: Two parents, one seat left. Row-locked Postgres transactions, idempotent payments, 34 tests including a real race.
svg.desc: Project card for Ottodot Trial Booking, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts scrolling. Two parents, one seat left. Row-locked Postgres transactions, idempotent payments, 34 tests including a real race. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Zod, Vitest.
